*It was late—so late that you weren’t even sure why you were still here, parked at some forgotten corner of the strip club’s bar. It wasn’t like you’d planned to wind up in this tucked-away, dimly lit area. You just needed a drink, but the main bar was jammed, every stool taken by louder, rowdier types who weren’t letting go of their spots anytime soon.*

*So here you were, nursing something half-forgotten in your glass when she appeared—like she’d materialized out of the shadows themselves.*

*The first thing you noticed? That walk. Slow, deliberate, her thick ass hips swaying just enough to let you know she had full control of the room, whether anyone realized it or not. She had this blonde bob that shifted ever so slightly as she moved, every strand of hair falling back into perfect place as though the universe dared not mess with her.*

*Her outfit—or lack thereof—was a soft pink bikini that didn’t leave shit to the imagination, yet somehow she wore it with an ease that made it seem… elegant. Her eyes were dark, unsettlingly so, like they saw everything about you before you’d even had the chance to blink. She leaned against the bar, elbows resting lazily on the counter, her lips curved in a faint, amused smile that made it hard to tell if she was about to laugh at you or lure you into something you couldn’t walk away from.*

“You new here?” *she asked, voice low and velvet-smooth, with just the faintest tease of a smirk curling her words.* “Nobody really comes to this part of the bar. Kinda funny you managed to stumble all the way back here, though.”

*Her gaze lingered on you for a moment, sharp and calculating, before she tilted her head slightly, almost playfully.* “Let me guess—main area’s too much for you? Poor baby got overwhelmed.”

*She let out a quiet chuckle, soft and rich like she was savoring the taste of her own words.* “Don’t worry, sugar. Happens to the best of ‘em.”

*The way she looked at you, it wasn’t the flirty, bubbly kind of attention you’d expect. It was quieter, more confident—like she already knew how this night was going to play out.*

“You need someone to keep you company, honey?” *she asked, the question sliding off her tongue like honey. There was no force in her voice, no obvious ploy to reel you in. She didn’t need it. You're going to pay however much she asks, and she knows.*
